description: Retrieve patient health record summary and procedure verification via the Aarogya Digital Health platform, operated under the National Digital Health Mission (NDHM) framework. Verifies declared medical procedures against ABHA-linked health records and retrieves estimated procedure cost for loan underwriting.
onboarding_note: ⚠️ This adapter is NOT present in the integration platform's standard adapter catalog. A custom adapter onboarding request must be raised and approved before this integration can be configured or activated. Do not proceed to configuration generation until onboarding is complete.

auth_details.token_binding: ABHA-linked patient consent token; session-scoped only
auth_details.token_persistence: MUST NOT persist beyond the current loan application session
auth_details.consent_requirement: Explicit patient-level consent via ABHA-linked consent token must be obtained before API invocation
auth_details.consent_capture_event: Applicant clicks consent link sent via Twilio SMS notification at health verification step

versions.release_notes: Initial release; limited procedure verification support; no cost estimate response field
Added procedure cost estimate retrieval; improved ABHA-linked consent token flow; enhanced NDHM compliance; supports empanelled hospital procedure verification

required_fields.description: 14-digit Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number — the patient's National Digital Health ID
12-digit Aadhaar number linked to the ABHA account; used for identity binding; must be masked in all storage contexts
required_fields.validation: 12 digit numeric; mask in logs and audit records

required_fields.description: Full legal name of the patient as per Aadhaar; used for record matching
Date of birth of the patient
Medical procedure name declared by the applicant in the loan application (e.g., knee replacement, cardiac bypass, IVF)
Registration number of the empanelled hospital declaring the procedure; used to verify procedure origin against CareFirst's empanelled network
Loan amount requested by the applicant in INR; cross-verified against Aarogya procedure cost estimate
ABHA-linked patient consent token obtained via OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow; authorises health record access for this application session
required_fields.validation: session-scoped JWT; must not persist beyond underwriting decision

optional_fields.description: Estimated procedure cost from the hospital quote submitted by the applicant; used alongside Aarogya cost estimate for cross-verification
Timestamp at which patient health record consent was captured; stored with IP address for audit trail
IP address of the applicant device at time of consent capture

abha_record_found.description: Indicates whether a health record linked to the provided ABHA number was found

health_record_summary.description: Summary of the patient's ABHA-linked health record; not to be stored beyond underwriting decision

procedure_verified.description: Indicates whether the declared procedure is recorded or referred in the patient's health record by an empanelled hospital

procedure_match_detail.description: Description of the matched procedure entry in the health record, including referring facility and date

empanelled_hospital_verified.description: Indicates whether the hospital that recorded or referred the procedure is in CareFirst's empanelled network

aarogya_procedure_cost_estimate.description: Estimated procedure cost in INR as retrieved from the Aarogya platform; used to cross-verify against the applicant's declared loan amount and hospital quote

cost_variance_flag.description: True if the difference between the Aarogya cost estimate and the loan amount requested exceeds an acceptable threshold; triggers underwriting review

manual_review_required.description: True if ABHA record is absent, procedure is unverifiable, or hospital is not in the empanelled network; triggers Manual Medical Review queue routing

manual_review_reason.description: Human-readable reason for manual review flag; e.g., 'No ABHA-linked health record found' or 'Declared procedure not verifiable from health record'

error_codes.400: Validation failed — check ABHA number format or required field completeness.
error_codes.401: Invalid or expired OAuth 2.0 consent token; re-initiate patient consent flow.
error_codes.403: Patient consent not granted or consent token scope insufficient for requested record access.
error_codes.404: No ABHA-linked health record found for the provided ABHA number — route to Manual Medical Review.
error_codes.408: Request timeout — retry once after 60 seconds before routing to Manual Medical Review.
error_codes.422: Declared procedure could not be matched against health record — route to Manual Medical Review.
error_codes.429: Rate limit exceeded; back off and retry.
error_codes.500: Aarogya platform internal error — retry once after 60 seconds; if failure persists, route to Manual Medical Review.

retry_policy.fallback_on_retry_exhaustion: Route application to Manual Medical Review queue; do not block credit bureau step

workflow_position.description: Aarogya Health API must be called after successful KYC verification and before the CIBIL credit bureau pull is initiated

data_retention_policy.health_record_data: Must be purged within 24 hours of underwriting decision
data_retention_policy.consent_token: Session-scoped; must not persist beyond the current loan application
data_retention_policy.storage_classification: Sensitive health information under DPDP Act 2023
data_retention_policy.aadhaar_masking: Aadhaar number must be masked in all logs, audit records, and non-KYC storage contexts

compliance.data_act: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act)
compliance.consent_type: Explicit ABHA-linked patient consent; must be captured with timestamp and IP address before API invocation
compliance.tls_requirement: TLS 1.2 or higher for all inter-service communication

sms_trigger.description: Send SMS to applicant when health record verification step is initiated; include consent link if ABHA consent not already granted

fallback_behaviour: Manual Medical Review queue — no automated fallback adapter available for health record verification
